nodes.name: Build Draft and Confirmation
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Confirm-before-save is the whole point of this workflow: an unconfirmed draft is never written.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO projects (tenant_id, sector_code, name, area, city, attributes, data_origin, is_active) SELECT '{{ $json.tenant_id }}', '{{ $json.sector_code }}', '{{ $json.draft_fields.name }}', '{{ $json.draft_fields.area }}', '{{ $json.draft_fields.city }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.draft_fields.attributes ?? {}) }}'::jsonb, 'real', true WHERE '{{ $json.action }}' = 'save' AND '{{ $json.draft_kind }}' = 'project'; INSERT INTO items (tenant_id, sector_code, name, price, currency, area, attributes, data_origin, is_active) SELECT '{{ $json.tenant_id }}', '{{ $json.sector_code }}', '{{ $json.draft_fields.name }}', {{ $json.draft_fields.price }}, (SELECT currency_code FROM tenants WHERE id = '{{ $json.tenant_id }}'::uuid), '{{ $json.draft_fields.area }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.draft_fields.attributes ?? {}) }}'::jsonb, 'real', true WHERE '{{ $json.action }}' = 'save' AND '{{ $json.draft_kind }}' = 'item'; INSERT INTO policies (tenant_id, policy_key, policy_value) SELECT '{{ $json.tenant_id }}', '{{ $json.draft_fields.policy_key }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.draft_fields.policy_value ?? {}) }}'::jsonb WHERE '{{ $json.action }}' = 'save' AND '{{ $json.draft_kind }}' = 'policy' ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, policy_key) DO UPDATE SET policy_value = EXCLUDED.policy_value, updated_at = now();
